prompt:
Create a new raster game icon sheet. Use attached robot and stamp ONLY as references for friendly rounded silhouette and thick crisp dark-navy outlines. The new rendering must be MUCH simpler, with clean solid flat color regions, exactly one discrete gentle shadow tone and one small solid highlight shape per color. Absolutely NO gradients, grain, fabric weave, texture, mottling, patchiness, airbrush or washed-out color.

Canvas landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, ideally 1536x1024. Genuine transparent alpha background. Invisible grid of 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells. Six separate icon groups in reading order. Each entire group centered within its cell, maximum dimension about 75% of cell width/height, plenty of even transparent margin. Same visual scale and gentle three-quarter front perspective. No grid lines, tiles, cast shadows, borders or backdrop.
Palette: white/warm cream object bodies; each object has only one or two accent colors drawn from teal, coral, sunny yellow, sky blue. Dark navy outlines. Leaf can be green-teal to satisfy the green leaf while keeping the limited palette. Smooth glossy cel-shaded storybook game look but with flat discrete tones, NOT gradients.
NO TEXT WHATSOEVER: no AI, no letters, no numbers, no branding or words. Screens very simple. No people or hands.

Row1 col1 SMART SPEAKER: round squat warm cream fabric-type smart speaker, imply fabric by simple shape ONLY, surface completely smooth and flat with no dots/mesh/weave. Teal light ring on top. No extra sound-wave effects.
Row1 col2 CALL TRANSLATOR: cream smartphone with sky-blue accent, screen has only one simple globe pictogram; two little blank speech bubbles beside phone, teal and coral. Readable as a call translation device, minimal details.
Row1 col3 PHOTO TRANSLATOR: cream phone angled suspended above a small cream paper menu, no hand. Screen contains a single unified menu-translation pictogram: miniature sheet with two abstract short strokes and a small globe speech bubble attached. Actual paper menu has a simple food pictogram, no words. Teal and coral accents only. Keep phone and menu clearly separate yet a compact centered group.
Row2 col1 PLANT FINDER: white phone, screen has a big green-teal leaf with a small check mark, together one simple plant-identification pictogram. No other screen widgets.
Row2 col2 FACE RECOGNITION LOCK: cream phone, sky-blue screen area showing just a simple dark navy face outline; a small sunny yellow OPEN padlock beside its lower right corner. Minimal face, no scanning clutter.
Row2 col3 SPELLING HELPER: open cream notebook with coral cover edge and a sunny yellow pencil alongside. Only one navy wavy line on page, gently circled in coral. Wavy line is abstract and NOT readable writing. Otherwise blank pages. No text on pencil.

Six icons exactly, arranged 3 across and 2 down. Match outline thickness throughout. Clean solid colors and sharply bounded shadow/highlight regions. Fully transparent background.
